change.title: Content update: rule 0291 for template T7

verdict.headline: Change w-r1z5/change/0291 is SAFE: new rule-0291 for template T7 accepted without rejection despite only specifying 2 of 21 required fields
verdict.cause: The change adds rule-0291 specifying only fields f02 and f21, while template T7 requires field_count=21. However, the "all other fields wildcard" mechanism means the 19 unspecified fields are treated as wildcards, satisfying the field_count=21 contract. The rule-validator checks_against contract (ic-0025) accepts the rule, and content-interpreter.load_rules evaluates with inputs_supplied=21 and exit_code=0. Experiments confirm: baseline 3 rules checked/0 rejected/exit 0; candidate 4 rules checked/0 rejected/exit 0 (new rule added and accepted); control matches baseline. No regression observed.
tested: x-e119d2c0a96e4300: baseline · workload default → all assertions passed
x-507d3dae5fcc4ccb: candidate · workload default → all assertions passed
x-0e1f030ea19b4ae0: control · workload default → all assertions passed
limitations: The experiments used the default workload only; edge cases with different field configurations or workload variants were not tested. The "wildcard" mechanism's exact behavior across all possible field combinations was not individually verified.
Baseline and candidate both passed under every tested workload.
